title: Recipe Viewer
description: Adds a menu to view the recipes of minecraft
body:
# Recipe Viewer

A simple Minecraft mod that lets you view all crafting recipes ingame.

**Features**
- View every crafting recipe easily
- Open the recipe menu with the R key
- Fast and simple interface
- Helpful for survival and modded gameplay

**Controls**
- Open GUI: "R"

**Compatibility**
- Client-side mod
- Works with most mods and crafting recipes
